The '''''Jendirian Valley III''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] leaving [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] when it collided with the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']]. While the ''Jenridian Valley III'' took minimal damage, the ''Envoy'' was wrecked and its co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Reeze Duurmun]] died in the impact.
